scope: All 32 mapped Grands-Échezeaux parcels inventoried; all 9 recorded right holders triaged at Tier 1. Not an exhaustive search of every archive.
rules: Candidate names are research hypotheses, never verified farmers.
Rights as of 2025-01-01, modern cadastral geometry and estate descriptions are different evidence.
A reviewed-at date or webpage crawl date is not a farming date.
Unmatched rights do not mean no owner or no farmer.
A cru intersection does not establish that the whole cadastral parcel is planted or farmed.
No automatic assignment from area, adjacency, named area, wine bottler, manager or similar company name.
Company filings record contributions and dated lease recitals; lease mandates are not proof of execution or current operation.
Research dates come from an explicitly selected source; supporting registry dates never fill an undated research source.
Disputed named-area locations are alternatives and contribute nothing to definite climat totals.

sources.title: DDT: Anne Gros application receipt, pp. 74–75
sources.finding: Dossier 2022-204 names applicant Anne Gros (11 rue des Communes, Vosne-Romanée) and previous operator Domaine Gros Frère et Sœur. Its annex includes Grands-Échezeaux D0093 (reference read from the page image, BFC reviewed-parcels). Outcome and actual operation unconfirmed.

sources.title: BFC bulletin 2026-067: order 2026-739 (BFC-2026-04-07-00015) suspending the SCEA Domaine du Comte Liger-Belair application
sources.finding: Suspends for eight months from publication (29 April 2026) the instruction of the SCEA Domaine du Comte Liger-Belair application, for excessive enlargement. Names Grands-Échezeaux D615 and D616 and, among the owners of the land applied for, SCEA Nathalie Pacareau Lamarche. Pages 28–30 read from the image.

sources.title: BFC regional bulletins 2019–2026: Côte-d'Or DDT notices mentioning Flagey, checked for Grands-Échezeaux
sources.finding: All 17 notices in the #410 index that mention Flagey or Échezeaux were checked. Six were already image-reviewed; the other 11 were downloaded (hashes matched the index) and their parcel lists read from the page images. Only D0093 (2022) and D0615/D0616 (2026) are Grands-Échezeaux references. Four notices concern Flagey-lès-Auxonne or only an address.

sources.title: Côte-d'Or departmental bulletins 2016–2020 (index #412)
sources.finding: The full-text search of 31,966 pages found one Flagey-Échezeaux vineyard decision (Maison Louis Bouillot, 2015), in section A. It names no Grands-Échezeaux reference; all Grands-Échezeaux parcels are in section D.

sources.title: DVF+ open-data (Cerema), sale and exchange deeds, Flagey-Échezeaux, 2014–2025
sources.finding: The hash-pinned April 2026 regional release keeps every deed since January 2014, without party names. 3 deeds touch 5 Grands-Échezeaux parcels. Prices and addresses are not kept.

sources.title: DGFiP legal-entity parcel files, situations at 1 January 2019–2024
sources.finding: Côte-d'Or members for each year were read by HTTP range and hash-pinned in scripts/grand-crus/bundles/flagey-echezeaux.json. They date company-type rights on each reference; they omit private individuals and say nothing about farming.

sources.title: Etalab cadastre vintages, Flagey-Échezeaux, 2019–2025
sources.finding: Seven hash-pinned vintages were compared with the 2026-06-01 geometry to find new references, retired references and spatial successors. Overlap is not a documented division act.

holders.finding: The recorded holder is the estate company itself (3.53 ha of the cru, four parcels). D0823's earlier records read SC DOM DE LA ROMANEE CONTI without a SIREN. The estate's Grands-Échezeaux page shows its figures only in a browser and was not read.

A family land-holding GFA (named MONGEARD MUGNERET ET FILS until 2019). The estate lists a Grands-Échezeaux wine but publishes no area; no lease was reviewed that says who farms the GFA's three parcels.

The operating estate lists a Grands-Échezeaux wine. D0681 was first recorded to it on 1 January 2024, after a sale deed of 21 November 2023. Kept separate from the GFA; farming of D0107 and D0681 unconfirmed.

The estate describes 0.5 ha at the extreme south of the appellation, above the Clos de Vougeot wall. D0111 and D0112 total 0.49 ha of the cru at its southern edge: consistent, but not a parcel-by-parcel statement.
A Beaune investment company (SEPV) whose board includes Jousset-Drouhin family members. Shared management only: not evidence that Drouhin farms D0103 or makes wine from it.

SAS Anne Gros is first recorded on D0093 on 1 January 2021. The 2022 receipt names Anne Gros, at the same address, as applicant for D0093 with previous operator Domaine Gros Frère et Sœur. Its outcome was not published.

First recorded on D0615 and D0616 on 1 January 2021. The April 2026 order suspending the Liger-Belair application names this SCEA among the owners of the land applied for. Who farms the parcels is not stated.
Provisional DGFiP identifier without a SIREN; the official company search found no match for the recorded name. No usable source located.
BICHOT SA is the Albert Bichot house company. No Grands-Échezeaux holding statement was read (the Clos Frantin product page tried returned 404).

exactParcelEvents.summary: Dossier 2022-204, complete at 21/10/2022, 1.5050 ha across Vosne-Romanée and Flagey-Échezeaux, including Grands-Échezeaux D0093; the receipt does not authorise cultivation.
exactParcelEvents.appNote: Receipt of a complete application. It is not an authorisation, and the outcome was not published in the bulletins searched.

exactParcelEvents.outcome: instruction suspended for eight months from 29 April 2026
exactParcelEvents.summary: The application covers 4.3080 ha in Flagey-Échezeaux, Boncourt-le-Bois, Vosne-Romanée and Vougeot, including Grands-Échezeaux D615 and D616. The region found the enlargement excessive and suspended the instruction, during which anyone may apply for the same land. As of the order, the applicant was not authorised to farm these parcels.
exactParcelEvents.appNote: Examination suspended for eight months from 29 April 2026 as an excessive enlargement. Anyone may apply for the same land meanwhile. Not an authorisation.

accessGaps: Tier 1 only: no company filings, deeds or leases (Tier 2) and no land-registry copies or outreach (Tier 3).
Private individuals are not in the legal-entity files: 13 parcels (2.06 ha of the cru) have no matched company record.
The Domaine de la Romanée-Conti Grands-Échezeaux page renders its figures in the browser and was not read.
SCI Dom Veuve Paul Modot has only a provisional DGFiP identifier and no match in the official company search.
Notices published outside the regional (2019–2026) and departmental (2016–2020) bulletins, and pre-2016 bulletins, were not searched.
Cadastral lineage covers the 2019–2026 vintages only. DVF+ sale records run from January 2014 to November 2025 and name no party.

historyFindings.title: D0681: sale deed, then a first company record
historyFindings.finding: A single-parcel sale deed is dated 21 November 2023, and Domaine Mongeard-Mugneret is first recorded on D0681 on 1 January 2024. The order fits a purchase by that company, but DVF names no buyer and the record says nothing about farming.

historyFindings.title: D0823 replaced D0097
historyFindings.finding: D0097 was last seen in the 2019 cadastre; D0823 first appears in 2020 and lies within it (31,019 m² shared). Its records name SC DOM DE LA ROMANEE CONTI until 2020 and DOMAINE DE LA ROMANEE CONTI from 2021; the earlier record has no SIREN, so continuity is not proved by the files alone.

producerHoldings.finding: Published as 0.5 ha at the extreme south of the appellation.
A Grands-Échezeaux wine is listed; no area is published.
